# cozystack_redis (Data Source)

Read an existing Cozystack Redis instance by name and namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cozystack_redis" "cache" {
  name      = "cache"
  namespace = "tenant-root"
}

output "cache_ready" {
  value = data.cozystack_redis.cache.ready
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Redis instance name.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace.

### Read-Only

- `auth_enabled` (Boolean) Whether authentication is enabled.
- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version.
- `external` (Boolean) Whether external access is enabled.
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier `namespace/name`.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the instance's `Ready` condition is true.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of Redis replicas.
- `resources` (Attributes) Explicit CPU and memory per replica, when set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `resources_preset` (String) Sizing preset.
- `size` (String) Persistent volume size.
- `storage_class` (String) StorageClass used to store the data.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`).
- `version` (String) Redis major version.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String) CPU available to each replica.
- `memory` (String) Memory available to each replica.
